name: extrudemore: helpers: a block, sketches and the page controls
extrudemore: up to surface: the end face picked on the block — a boss from below stops at its top face
extrudemore: up to vertex: the corner of the block picked through its top face; then offset from surface (5 short of it)
extrudemore: thin feature: an open L of lines, 2 thick, through the page (Thin Feature box, thickness field)
extrudemore: selected contours: two rectangles, the second one unchecked — only the first is extruded
